title: Extract duplicated validation logic into shared module
description: Three separate modules each re-implement near-identical email/phone/postal-code validation with subtle inconsistencies (different regexes, different trimming behavior). Extract a single shared validation module used by all three call sites, preserving each call site's externally observable validation behavior for currently-valid and currently-invalid inputs used in existing tests.
acceptanceCriteria: All three call sites import validation logic from one new shared module rather than local copies.
No duplicated validation regex/logic remains in the three original modules.
All pre-existing tests for the three call sites continue to pass unchanged.
The shared module has its own direct unit tests independent of the three call sites.
verificationMethod: diff-analysis: confirm the three original modules no longer contain the duplicated logic, combined with a test-suite run of both existing and new shared-module tests.
groundTruth: A single validation module exports isValidEmail, isValidPhone, isValidPostalCode; each call site is updated to import and delegate to these, with any previously-inconsistent behavior reconciled to match whichever behavior the existing tests actually assert.
